name: Ultra Glass Cleaner

features.text: Removes dirt, grime, smoke film, fingerprints.

description: A concentrated, VOC-compliant glass cleaner that removes dust, grime, film and fingerprints from glass, mirrors, and chrome without streaks. Contains no ammonia.
application: MIXING INSTRUCTIONS: Option 1: Dilution by proportioner. Remove cap, create a hole in the center of the cap or secure cap/draw tube assembly from MOC Recon Cabinet system. Place draw tube of the proportioner into the container. Set dilution ratio on proportioner to desired concentration. Operate proportioner per manufacturer’s instructions. Option 2: Transfer desired amount of product to a clean empty 55-gallon container. Fill container with filtered water until full. Apply secondary label LB6746S to drum
review: Has a Performance Ratings section: Concentration - 8
